thread:
evan: quick alert — during a staging soak we saw a bunch of requests charged to the wrong quota bucket. looks related to shard alias normalization.
mina: which component touched aliases? cluster-syncer or proxy shim?
ev an: cluster-syncer pushed a mapping update at 02:10, then panicked a few minutes later. proxy applied normalization and started rewriting shard names.
sara: console shows many requests labelled shard=legacy-east which shouldn't exist anymore. quota ledger attributes went to default-tenant.
cj: can you paste the syncer stacktrace?
ev an: stacktrace snippet: `panic: runtime error: slice bounds out of range` at github.com/redwood/cluster-syncer/sync.go:242. full logs in INC-2026-091.
mina: mitigation: flip off normalization in the proxy config for staging: `route_normalize=false`. that'll keep original headers intact.
deploy-bot: rolling config change: route_normalize=false -> staging-proxy-01..03 :hourglass_flowing_sand:
deploy-bot: config rollout complete on 3/3 nodes.
qa-bot: running itinerary: shard-alias-smoke-test v1 against staging. posting results shortly.
sara: i'll add a short telemetry flag `route_mutated=true/false` on the proxy so we canchart how often we alter headers historically. also emit `syncer_last_ok` metric with timestamp.
cj: for longer-term: add defensive parsing in cluster-syncer and an age-check: if mapping age > 1h, don't normalize.
ev an: agree. i'll open a PR with the panic fix and the age-gate.
mina: SDK side: let's add a lint in python/go clients that rejects deprecated alias names at build/test time. and TS runtime should warn if it sees deprecated aliases in dev builds. prevents clients from sending ambiguous strings.
sara: can we also add a console dashboard tile showing `route_mutated` rate + affected tenants? product wants quick visibility for rollouts.
j: good idea — tag the metric with tenant, model-route, and `mutation_reason=syncer|proxy`.
qa-bot: smoke-test results: 50/50 with old mapping present -> 0 mismatches after rollback.
ev an: next steps: revert to normalized behavior after syncer fix is deployed + tenant-opt-in flag. i'll coordinate a staged rollout.
mina: posting a tiny python smoke-test gist: https://gist.github.com/mina/shard-alias-smoke-test-2026 (priv). use it to validate post-fix.
sara: creating a console card mock for PM review. will include a quicklink to affected traces.
deploy-bot: scheduling canary for cluster-syncer hotfix: job-9009 queued.
ev an: thanks all. follow-ups: PRs for syncer fix, proxy age-gate, telemetry tags, and SDK lint. will sync at 10:30.
